number: 第二百四十八条の四の二十六
heading_en: CVA Sensitivities for Equity Risk Buckets
summary_ja: 株式リスクのバケットを時価総額、経済、発行体セクターで定め（注記あり）、バケット間相関を表で定める。
summary_en: Equity risk buckets are defined by market capitalization, economy and issuer sector (with explanatory notes), and inter-bucket correlations are set out in a table.
paragraphs: The equity risk buckets shall be as set out in the following table, according to each category of market capitalization, economy and equity issuer sector listed in that table. {{T:p294t1}} (Note 1) In classifying the "market capitalization" column of the table, the following requirements shall be satisfied. 1. Use the total market capitalization, based on the market value of the total number of issued shares of the same listed company or corporate group, across securities markets worldwide. 2. The total number of issued shares of a corporate group shall be the total number of issued shares of the listed parent company within the group. 3. The market capitalizations of multiple related listed companies shall not be included in the total number of issued shares of a corporate group. 4. Where the market capitalization is US$2 billion or more, classify it as "large", and otherwise classify it as "small". (Note 2) In classifying the "economy" column of the table, the following requirements shall be satisfied. 1. "Advanced markets" shall be Canada, the United States, Mexico, the euro area, Western European countries outside the euro area (the United Kingdom, Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Switzerland), Japan, Oceania (Australia and New Zealand), Singapore and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. 2. "Emerging markets" shall be countries or regions other than "advanced markets". (Note 3) In classifying the "equity issuer sector" column of the table, the following matters shall be kept in mind. 1. Allocation shall be based on the sectors commonly used in the market. 2. Each issuer shall be allocated to one of the sectors in the table, and issuers belonging to the same industry shall be allocated to the same sector. 3. Where it is difficult to allocate an issuer to an appropriate sector, it shall be allocated to bucket number 11. 4. An issuer belonging to different economies or to multiple sectors shall be allocated to the bucket corresponding to the most important economy or sector in which that issuer conducts its business activities.

The correlation coefficient γ_{bc} between buckets of equity delta risk and between buckets of vega risk shall be as set out in the following table, according to the bucket number (meaning the bucket number classified under the preceding paragraph; the same applies in paragraph (3) of the following Article). {{T:p296t0}}
